entry.name: jit.3m
entry.description: Reports the minimum, mean, and maximum values for each plane of a given input matrix as lists of size planecount , one value for each plane. The list of minimum values are sent out the left outlet of the object, the list of mean values are sent out the middle outlet, and the list of maximum values is sent out the right outlet.
